articles.title_en: Yalcouye header secures narrow win for Brighton at Getafe
articles.title_ja: Yalcouye header secures narrow win for ブライトン at Getafe
articles.summary_ja: Malick Yalcouye's second-half header secured a narrow 1-0 win for ブライトン at Getafe as Fabian Hurzeler's side moved into the top eight of the Conference League.
